intent: The verdict and the model's own standing counterweigh each other in the opening view; the standing row's five figures share one presence that also sets their label binding and cell rhythm; the hindcast ledger's row rhythm and its inside/outside bracket accent move together as one instrument.

titlePresence.why: Relative prominence of the room title 'Simulation' against this composition's baseline.

titleBase.why: Authored room-title size in rem for this composition's baseline.

verdictGapBase.why: Authored gap in rem between the room title and the verdict line at baseline presence.

titleVerdictElasticity.why: Counterbalance: as the title looms larger it should read as one fused statement with the verdict, so the gap contracts.

standingGapBase.why: Authored gap in rem between the opening block and the standing instrument row at baseline presence.

titleStandingElasticity.why: Counterweight: as the title looms larger, the standing row needs a touch more separation to keep its own register (instrument, not prose) so the two sides hold each other apart.

figurePresence.why: Relative size of the five standing instrument figures (Tier, Skill, Coverage, Calibrated, Parameters) against baseline.

figureBase.why: Authored standing-figure size in rem at baseline presence.

labelGapBase.why: Authored gap in rem between a standing figure and its caption label at baseline presence.

figureLabelElasticity.why: Counterbalance: a larger figure binds tighter to its own caption so the pair still reads as one instrument, not two.

rowIntervalBase.why: Authored gap in rem between adjacent standing-row cells at baseline presence.

rowPresence.why: Relative density of the eight hindcast ledger rows against baseline.

hindcastIntervalBase.why: Authored vertical rhythm in rem for hindcast ledger rows at baseline presence.

bracketBase.why: Authored width in px of each hindcast row's inside/outside bracket accent at baseline presence.

titleSize.why: The room title follows its own presence directly.

verdictGap.why: Counterbalance: the verdict line draws closer to the title as the title grows.

standingGap.why: Counterweight: the standing row holds a touch more distance as the title grows, so verdict and standing stay legible as two different kinds of claim sharing one view.

figureSize.why: Each standing figure follows the row's shared presence (shared ancestry: one origin, five members).

labelGap.why: Counterbalance: a larger figure binds tighter to its caption so growth reads as emphasis, not drift.

rowInterval.why: Shared ancestry: the gap between instrument cells grows with the figures it separates, so five instruments never collide.

hindcastInterval.why: Rhythm: the ledger's eight rows keep one interval that loosens or tightens as a whole, never row by row.

hindcastBracket.why: The inside/outside bracket accent belongs to the same rhythm family as the row interval it marks, so a denser ledger gets a quieter mark and a looser one a firmer mark.
